name: To Be Altered
source:
Uncover the mystery of the Ghoul's Grove, hidden in the Australian outback and filled with strange and mutilated scare actors. Darcy, an ex-detective, and his curious daughter, Jess, uncover the truth about the horrors of the carnival when they find one of the disfigured employees murdered. Play as Darcy in this multiple-choice visual novel to find out who did it, but should you have bailed when you had the chance?

[from https://skellybed.itch.io/to-be-altered]
translation:
揭开食尸鬼丛林的神秘面纱，这里隐藏在澳大利亚内陆地区，里面到处都是奇怪且残缺不全的恐怖演员。前侦探达西和他好奇的女儿杰西发现一名毁容的员工被谋杀后，揭开了狂欢节恐怖的真相。在这部多项选择视觉小说中扮演达西，找出是谁干的，但当你有机会时，你应该放弃吗？

[来自https://skellybed.itch.io/to-be-altered]
